en: Windows that open on the other Mac come over only when your click or key led to them, including apps you start from its Finder; apps opened there by someone else or by themselves stay there.
Choose a frame rate of up to 144 Hz for each Mac in Video Quality.
zh-Hans: 只有你的点击或按键引出的窗口才会出现在这台 Mac 上，包括你在对方 Finder 里启动的 app；对方 Mac 上别人打开或自行启动的 app 会留在那里。
可以在“视频画质”中为每台 Mac 选择最高 144 Hz 的帧率。
